description: Environment-Scoped Secrets (NO prefixes) - Aligned with Working Pipeline
architecture: GitHub Environment Secrets with identical names across all environments

PAT.description: Personal Access Token for GitHub API operations

XAI_API_KEY.description: xAI API key (optional; used by experimental AI tooling)

SENTRY_DSN.description: Sentry DSN (used for backend + frontend error reporting)
SENTRY_DSN.note: May also be configured as an environment secret per lane; keep names consistent with workflows.

REACT_APP_SENTRY_DSN.description: Frontend Sentry DSN (optional; if set overrides using SENTRY_DSN for frontend)
REACT_APP_SENTRY_DSN.note: If unset, pipeline may pass SENTRY_DSN through to the frontend as REACT_APP_SENTRY_DSN.

SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Sentry auth token (used by CI release tooling and backend AI assistant Sentry queries)

SSH_HOST.note: Different value per environment, same name

SSH_USER.note: Different value per environment, same name

SSH_KEY.note: NOT currently used, kept for compatibility

BACKEND_HOST.description: Backend server IP/hostname for nginx routing
BACKEND_HOST.note: Used by frontend to proxy API requests

DOMAIN_NAME.description: Primary domain name for the environment
DOMAIN_NAME.note: Used for frontend runtime config and health checks

DJANGO_SECRET_KEY.description: Django secret key for cryptographic signing

ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed hosts for Django
ALLOWED_HOSTS.note: Leading dot enables wildcard subdomain matching: .dev.meatscentral.com matches *.dev.meatscentral.com, .meatscentral.com matches *.meatscentral.com

EMAIL_BACKEND.note: Use console backend for dev, SMTP for production

EMAIL_HOST_PASSWORD.description: SMTP authentication password or API key
EMAIL_HOST_PASSWORD.note: For SendGrid, this is your API key

DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL.description: Default email address for outgoing emails

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID.description: Microsoft Azure AD Application (client) ID for OAuth

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Microsoft Azure AD client secret for OAuth

MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID.description: Microsoft Azure AD tenant ID (or 'common' for multi-tenant)
MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID.note: Use 'common' for multi-tenant apps, specific tenant ID for single-tenant

MICROSOFT_REDIRECT_URI.description: Microsoft OAuth redirect/callback URI (must match Azure app registration)
MICROSOFT_REDIRECT_URI.note: Use primary domain + /api/v1/... routing for stability (see manifests/GOLDEN_FILES.md)

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth client ID for Gmail integration
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.note: Optional until Gmail integration is enabled. Create a Google Cloud OAuth client and enable Gmail API.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Google OAuth client secret for Gmail integration
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.note: Optional until Gmail integration is enabled. Store as an environment secret; never commit.

GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI.description: Google OAuth redirect/callback URI (must match Google app registration)
GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI.note: Should match /api/v1/email/gmail/auth/callback/ for the target environment domain.

GMAIL_PUBSUB_TOPIC.description: Google Cloud Pub/Sub topic for Gmail push notifications (Gmail API watch)
GMAIL_PUBSUB_TOPIC.note: Example: projects/<project-id>/topics/gmail-push. Required for Gmail watch subscribe/renew endpoints.

GMAIL_PUBSUB_VERIFICATION_TOKEN.description: Shared token for verifying Gmail Pub/Sub push requests (configure the Pub/Sub push URL as ?token=...)
GMAIL_PUBSUB_VERIFICATION_TOKEN.security: Store as a GitHub Environment Secret; never commit.
GMAIL_PUBSUB_VERIFICATION_TOKEN.note: If set, /gmail/webhook/notifications/ will only process requests that include a matching token query param.

GOOGLE_PUBSUB_AUDIENCE.description: Expected audience for Google-signed OIDC JWTs on Pub/Sub push requests
GOOGLE_PUBSUB_AUDIENCE.note: If set, /gmail/webhook/notifications/ can verify Authorization: Bearer <OIDC JWT> when Pub/Sub push OIDC is enabled.

OAUTH_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Fernet key for encrypting stored OAuth tokens (ExternalAuthProvider)
OAUTH_ENCRYPTION_KEY.security: NEVER commit. Store in GitHub Environment Secrets.
OAUTH_ENCRYPTION_KEY.note: Generate with: python -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())"

FRONTEND_URL.description: Frontend URL used for invitation links and email templates
FRONTEND_URL.note: Critical for ensuring invitation emails contain correct environment URLs

REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL.description: API base URL for frontend runtime config (sub-path routing)
REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL.note: Uses /api/v1 sub-path routing (no separate API subdomains)

REDIS_URL.description: Redis connection URL for caching and real-time features
REDIS_URL.note: Preferred cache/channels URL. Development keeps explicit local fallback when not set. When REQUIRE_REDIS_READINESS is enabled for a non-dev backend lane, either REDIS_URL or VALKEY_URL must be present.

VALKEY_URL.description: Valkey connection URL for cache and channel backends
VALKEY_URL.note: Alternative to REDIS_URL for lanes backed by Valkey. When REQUIRE_REDIS_READINESS is enabled for a non-dev backend lane, either REDIS_URL or VALKEY_URL must be present.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key for AI-powered features
OPENAI_API_KEY.note: Required for Phase 2 (AI field suggestions, NLP processing, dynamic workflow generation). AI features disabled if not set.
OPENAI_API_KEY.security: NEVER commit to repository. Store only in GitHub Secrets.

OPENAI_ORG_ID.note: Only required if using organization-scoped API keys

OPENAI_MODEL.description: OpenAI model to use for AI features
OPENAI_MODEL.note: gpt-4 recommended for production quality, gpt-3.5-turbo for cost savings

UNSTRUCTURED_API_URL.note: Optional; used for document extraction/processing integrations.

UNSTRUCTURED_API_KEY.security: NEVER commit to repository. Store only in GitHub Secrets.

SENTRY_DSN.description: Sentry Data Source Name for error tracking
SENTRY_DSN.note: Required for Phase 6.4 (Sentry APM integration). Error tracking disabled if not set.

SENTRY_ENABLED.note: Even if SENTRY_DSN is set, Sentry won't initialize unless this is 'true'

SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT.description: Sentry environment name for event tagging

SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Sentry auth token for the Sentry API (used by AI assistant tooling)
SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN.security: NEVER commit to repository. Store only in GitHub Secrets.
SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN.note: Required for the AI assistant get_recent_errors tool to fetch recent issues tagged with tenant_id.

SENTRY_ORG_SLUG.description: Sentry organization slug (used to build Sentry API URLs)
SENTRY_ORG_SLUG.note: Required for the AI assistant get_recent_errors tool.

SENTRY_PROJECT_SLUG.description: Sentry project slug (used by CI to create Releases for Seer Suspect Commits)
SENTRY_PROJECT_SLUG.note: Optional, but required to enable getsentry/action-release in .github/workflows/main-pipeline.yml.

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID.note: Required for Phase 5 (Microsoft OAuth, Outlook integration). Integration disabled if not set.

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET.security: NEVER commit to repository. Store only in GitHub Secrets.

MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID.note: Required for organization-specific OAuth. Use 'common' for multi-tenant apps.

MICROSOFT_REDIRECT_URI.note: Used by OAuth authorize endpoint; must match Azure app registration.

validation.required_secret_source: Derived from repository_secrets/environment_secrets entries where required=true, filtered by applies_to and used_by metadata.

notes.architecture_change: Version 5.0 reflects the ACTUAL working pipeline. All secrets use identical names across environments and are scoped to GitHub Environments (not prefixed).
notes.secret_isolation: Secrets are isolated by GitHub Environment scope (dev-backend, dev-frontend, uat-backend, etc.), NOT by name prefixes.
notes.deployment_workflow: See .github/workflows/main-pipeline.yml and .github/workflows/reusable-deploy.yml for actual secret usage, and .github/scripts/validate-environment.sh for manifest-driven lane validation.
notes.audit_script_status: manage_env.py audit and validate-environment.sh are aligned with the v5.1 lane-scoped secret model.
